# CvBFF — Full AI Crawler Reference

> AI resume builder and CV tailoring Chrome extension. Paste any job posting and get a tailored resume, cover letter, and fit score in seconds. Pay per use — no subscription needed.

## What CvBFF Does

CvBFF is an AI-powered resume and CV builder available as a Chrome extension and web app. It generates a fully tailored resume (or CV) and cover letter for each specific job a user applies to, using their saved work history and profile data. The output is keyword-optimised for ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) and formatted for immediate use.

## How It Works

1. The user installs the CvBFF Chrome extension or visits the web app at cvbff.com.
2. They browse to any job posting on any job board (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, company career pages, etc.).
3. They click "Read this page" — CvBFF reads and extracts the job description automatically.
4. They click "Apply to job" to start the generation flow.
5. They select a CV template (4 options) and colour scheme (6 options).
6. They select CV length: 1, 2, or 3 pages.
7. The AI (Claude by Anthropic) generates a tailored resume and cover letter matched to the specific job posting, drawing only from the user's real saved experience — no hallucinations or invented content.
8. The user receives a free preview. Unlocking the full document costs 1 credit.
9. The user also receives a fit score (0–100) explaining how well their profile matches the role, plus tailored interview prep suggestions.
10. All applications, CVs, and cover letters are automatically saved to the user's applications tracker.

## What Makes CvBFF Different

- **Chrome extension**: Works directly on any job board, no copy-pasting required. The extension reads the job posting from the page the user is already on.
- **Pay-per-use credits**: No subscription. Users buy credits and spend 1 per document unlock or regeneration. Starting from $1.99 for 10 credits.
- **Based on real profile data**: CvBFF stores the user's full work history, skills, education, certifications, and languages. The AI tailors from this real data — it cannot invent experience.
- **4 CV templates**: Classic, Executive, Minimal, and Thick Underline.
- **6 colour schemes**: Users choose the visual style of their CV.
- **1, 2, or 3 page CVs**: Content is automatically scaled and prioritised to fill the selected page count without overflow or blank space.
- **ATS-optimised output**: Keywords from the job posting are naturally incorporated. The AI is instructed to avoid AI-sounding artefacts and produce human-sounding language.
- **Applications tracker**: Every generated CV and cover letter is saved. Users can track application status (Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected), filter, sort, and delete entries.
- **Fit score and interview prep**: Each generation includes a 0–100 fit score with explanation and a set of interview preparation suggestions specific to the role.
- **Inline editing**: Users can manually edit any part of their generated CV or cover letter before downloading.
- **Google OAuth**: Sign in with Google is fully supported alongside email/password.

## Pricing Model

CvBFF uses a credit system with no subscription:
- Unlocking a CV: 1 credit
- Unlocking a cover letter: 1 credit
- Regenerating a CV or cover letter: 1 credit
- Previewing is always free
- Credits are purchased via Stripe. Starting from $1.99 for 10 credits.

## Technical Details

- Frontend: Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS. Chrome Extension (Manifest V3).
- Backend: Supabase (authentication and database).
- AI: Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6) via a Cloudflare Worker proxy.
- Payments: Stripe.
- The Cloudflare Worker validates the user's JWT, checks credits, calls Claude, and returns results. Credit deduction is server-side only.

## Blog Posts

- [AI CV Tailoring Guide](https://cvbff.com/blog/ai-cv-tailoring-guide): How AI CV tailoring works, what to expect, and how to use it without getting burned. Covers the difference between generic AI and purpose-built tools, and what good tailoring actually looks like in 2026.
- [ChatGPT vs AI Resume Builders](https://cvbff.com/blog/chatgpt-vs-cv-tools): A detailed comparison of using ChatGPT versus a dedicated AI resume builder for job applications. Covers hallucination risk, context loss, formatting gaps, and when each tool is the right choice.
- [5 Resume Mistakes Costing You Interviews](https://cvbff.com/blog/cv-mistakes-costing-you-interviews): The five most common CV and resume mistakes that cause applications to be rejected before a human reads them, and how to fix each one.
- [CV Personal Statement Examples](https://cvbff.com/blog/cv-personal-statement-examples): Real examples of strong personal statements (also called CV summaries or professional profiles), plus a formula for writing one that works for any role.
- [CV Skills Section Guide](https://cvbff.com/blog/cv-skills-section): What to include in the skills section, how to order it, what to leave out, and how to tailor it for every application. Includes ATS considerations.
- [CV vs Resume](https://cvbff.com/blog/cv-vs-resume): The definitive guide to the difference between a CV and a resume, when to use each, and how terminology varies by country and industry.
- [CV With No Experience](https://cvbff.com/blog/cv-with-no-experience): A guide for students, graduates, and first-time job seekers on how to build a CV that gets interviews when you have no formal work experience.
- [How to Beat ATS Systems](https://cvbff.com/blog/how-to-beat-ats-systems): How applicant tracking systems work, why CVs get filtered out, and how to optimise your resume to pass ATS legitimately — without gaming or keyword stuffing.
- [How to Write a Cover Letter](https://cvbff.com/blog/how-to-write-a-cover-letter): A 4-part cover letter structure that gets read in 2026, with examples and a template. Covers what modern recruiters look for and what to avoid.
- [How to Write Work Experience on a CV](https://cvbff.com/blog/how-to-write-work-experience-cv): How to structure the work experience section, write bullet points that impress, use metrics, and tailor entries for each job application.
- [Job Search Strategy](https://cvbff.com/blog/job-search-strategy): A practical workflow for applying to 20 quality jobs in a 2-hour session, with batch triage, profile setup, application tracking, and avoiding the spammer vs perfectionist failure modes.
- [How to Tailor Your CV to a Job Posting](https://cvbff.com/blog/tailor-your-cv-to-a-job-posting): Step-by-step guide to keyword matching, mirroring job description language, reordering experience, and passing ATS filters for each application.
